notes.text: 10 trees, 8 illuminated posts and 6 planted edge details turn the plinth into a complete public setting. Copper Canyon Mammoth is a 3D voxel solid 1,902 stud columns across and 36 courses tall, laid as 27,207 cross-bonded brick cells on a 112 x 64-stud scene. The two-layer foundation cross-bonds every row into one editable, stable model.
